definitions.explanation: A mounted warrior of medieval Europe or a similar figure in other cultures. In modern usage, commonly appears in fantasy fiction, games, and historical references.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{騎士|きし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}んじた→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{王国|おうこく}→王国：15857_oukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{若|わか}い{騎士|きし}だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of this story is a young knight who sets out on a journey to defend the kingdom.

notes:
Compound of {騎|き} (riding/mounted) + ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (warrior/person of rank).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騎士|きし}{団|だん} (order of knights; knightly order)
- {騎士|きし}{道|どう} (chivalry)
- {聖|せい}{騎士|きし} (holy knight, paladin)
- ⟦{暗黒|あんこく}→暗黒：12997_ankoku⟧{騎士|きし} (dark knight)
- {騎士|きし}{道|どう}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (spirit of chivalry)

USAGE:
Used primarily for Western knights. For Japanese mounted warriors, {騎馬武者|きばむしゃ} is used instead. Very common in fantasy literature, anime, manga, and video games, where it often forms part of character class names.
